standard_en.summary: During orthogonal redistribution, keeps the total rank from exceeding the conventional
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: orthogonal 重分配时，确保总 rank 数不超过传统 LoRA（所有层 × network_dim）。关闭则允许重点层获得更多 rank。

advanced_en.principle: During orthogonal reallocation, keeps total rank within the traditional LoRA budget (all layers × network_dim). Turning this off lets key layers receive more rank.
